eyebrow: Spot instances: real discount, real catch
code:
On-demand GPU:  full price, never reclaimed
Spot/preemptible: 60-90% cheaper, BUT can be
  reclaimed with little warning (seconds-minutes)

Good fit: batch jobs, queue-and-worker patterns
Bad fit: a user actively waiting on this request
caption: A reclaimed worker means the job retries elsewhere -- not that a user sees an error.

code:
Traffic/latency alerts ask:
  "is the service healthy?"

Cost alerts ask:
  "is it still cheap enough to run this way?"

"Working as configured" != "configured sensibly"
caption: A perfectly healthy service can still be quietly burning far more than expected.
